run_telegram_bot: run the telegram bot application that streams LLM responses to allowed users via python-telegram-bot
handle_message_send_prompt: handle incoming telegram messages by queuing prompts to the GeneraticAgent and streaming responses
abort_running_task: abort the current GeneraticAgent task and cancel the active streaming response in telegram
switch_llm_model: switch between available LLM models in the GeneraticAgent by index using the /llm command
stream_llm_response_with_files: stream LLM responses to telegram with markdown-to-HTML conversion and auto-send attached files
